newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni unit starts developing Ecuador oil well.
newsitem.headline: Eni unit starts developing Ecuador oil well.

text.p: The oil exploration arm of Italian energy group Eni, in conjunction with ARCO Oriente Inc, has begun developing an oil well in east Ecuador which will go on line in 1999, the group said in a statement.
ARCO owns 60 percent of the Villano well while Eni's Agip unit owns 40 percent, the statement said. The well will produce an initial 30,000 barrels of oil a day.
The development plan included the construction of a 130 km pipeline to transport the oil to a processing plant in Baenza. It will have a capacity of 80,000 barrels a day.
"The development of the Villano field, including the additional pipeline, will be completed to allow production to start in 1999," the statement said.
It added that it expected to produce around 160 million barrels of oil over the next 20 year.
